d:
The Motorola Edge 70 Pro looks like a straightforward upgrade over the Edge 70 — better specs, bigger battery, and improved cameras. But after spending time with it, things aren’t quite that simple.
In this video, we unbox the Edge 70 Pro and take a closer look at what it brings to the table — design, display, performance, cameras, battery, and software — to see how it actually performs in real-world use. It gets a lot right, especially with its sleek design, strong low-light camera performance, and powerful hardware… but there are a couple of surprising trade-offs too.
